auth-confirmed.welcome-message: Your GymHajime journey starts now. Build routines, track your progress, and train with purpose.

header.logout-message: Are you sure you want to log out?

hajime-info.closing: Your routine. Your progress. Your Hajime.

introduction.build: Build a weekly training schedule that works for you, choose your exercises, track every session and see your progress over time.
introduction.idea: GymHajime is built around a simple idea: stop waiting, break the routine, and begin.
introduction.verb: From the Japanese verb hajimeru (始める): “to begin” or “to start.”

dashboard.paragraph-1: Stay focused on what matters right now.
dashboard.paragraph-2: See yesterday’s workout, today’s training, and tomorrow’s plan at a glance.
dashboard.paragraph-3: Use it as your daily reminder of where you’ve been, what you need to do today, and what comes next.
dashboard.title: DASHBOARD

discover.paragraph-1: You don’t have to build your routine alone.
discover.paragraph-2: Discover other GymHajime users and explore the training schedules they choose to make public.
discover.paragraph-3: Find new exercises, get inspiration from how others train, and discover routines that might work for you.
discover.paragraph-4: Eventually, find a routine you like? Make it your own.
discover.title: DISCOVER

plan.paragraph-2: Choose exercises, sets and reps and always know what you’re training next.
plan.title: PLAN

progress.paragraph-1: Keep a history of your workouts and see how your strength, consistency and performance develop.
progress.title: PROGRESS

train.paragraph-1: Turn your planned workout into a real training session.
train.paragraph-2: Record your sets, reps and weights as you train.
train.title: TRAIN

hajime-info.subtitle: HAJIME — BEGIN
hajime-info.title: 始め
